banner.title: Film & cinema
banner.lede: Super-8 and 16mm transfers. Six-minute story films, scored, hand-edited from a season's footage.

reels.title: Amélie & Pierre
reels.description: Six minutes of a Provençal Saturday — vows in the cypresses, dinner under the bulbs, and the long walk back.

reels.title: The lawn ceremony
reels.description: Three rolls of Super-8 in the rain, then sun, then candlelight. A film about weather, mostly.

reels.title: The long table
reels.description: Twelve courses, four hours, one thunderstorm — scored for cello and felt piano.
